content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was a mishandling of the EDID (Extended Display Identification Data) when it was determined to be zero or invalid. Specifically, after refactoring the code to separate the reading of the base block of the EDID into its own function, the logic for handling cases where the EDID was all zeros or invalid was broken. Instead of passing the actual broken EDID to the `connector_bad_edid()` function, an error pointer was being passed, which led to a crash when the system attempted to process the invalid EDID. The patch corrects this by ensuring that the bad EDID is passed correctly to the error handling function.
